title: Clyde Blakey — obituary
text:
Clyde Blakey

SAVOY — Funeral will be held at 2 p.m. Thursday at the First Methodist Church here for Clyde Blakey, 67, who died at his home here early today. Interment will be in the Sunnywide Cemetery under the direction of Earnheart Funeral Home of Whitewright.

Blakey was born Nov. 5, 1898 in Fannin County and married Lera Nix Nov. 23, 1937 at Ector. He was a retired farmer and a Methodist.

Surviving is his wife; a brother, James of Savoy; and a sister, Mrs. Ina Elk of Savoy.
notes: Handwritten annotation '1927 ?' visible at right margin (likely a date notation for filing). Cemetery name printed as 'Sunnywide' — possibly Sunnyside Cemetery. Bottom of clipping shows the beginning of another article ('Bobby Redman') which is cut off.
